NONLINEAR, NONHOMOGENEOUS ROBIN PROBLEMS WITH
INDEFINITE POTENTIAL AND GENERAL REACTION
N.S. PAPAGEORGIOU, V.D. R˘ADULESCU, AND D.D. REPOVˇS
Abstract. We consider a nonlinear elliptic equation driven by a nonhomogeneous diﬀerential
operator plus an indeﬁnite potential. On the reaction term we impose conditions only near zero.
Using variational methods, together with truncation and perturbation techniques and critical
groups, we produce three nontrivial solutions with sign information. In the semilinear case we
improve this result by obtaining a second nodal solution for a total of four nontrivial solutions.
Finally, under a symmetry condition on the reaction term, we generate a whole sequence of distinct
nodal solutions.

Abstract: We consider a nonlinear elliptic equation driven by a nonhomogeneous diﬀerential operator plus an indeﬁnite potential. On the reaction term we impose conditions only near zero. Using variational methods, together with truncation and perturbation techniques and critical groups, we produce three nontrivial solutions with sign information. In the semilinear case we improve this result by obtaining a second nodal solution for a total of four nontrivial solutions. Finally, under a symmetry condition on the reaction term, we generate a whole sequence of distinct nodal solutions.
